analysis:
The two supplied units are head-side text for StandaloneServer.swift lines 588-1779: shutdown/lifecycle (waitUntilStopped, stop, finishShutdown), test seams, reslice/build, LRU eviction, acquireModel and the start of ensureModelLoaded. Per file_changes, the only changed head ranges are 1964-1969 and 1999-2006, which are outside these units, and the patch excerpt is truncated. I could not see the actual diff lines or the replacement code.

The visible code does not appear to be altered by the PR. It carries the pre-existing cacheEligibleWeightHash, modelArtifactSHA256 and weightHash parameters through resliceAndBuildBundle (lines 1271-1272, 1298-1299). It also contains lifecycle fail-closed guards such as requireNativeMiMoNewWorkAllowed and the lifecycleDraining checks. I found no regression in the visible code.

The patch excerpt shows a security-relevant change in the unseen region. For GLM managed loads, the pre-load and post-load computeStandaloneWeightHash passes are dropped. The explicit comparison of the hash to glmPlan.weights.manifest.aggregateSHA256 (identityMismatch) is also removed. The replacement relies on the GLM native load SHA-256-verifying every manifest file and supplying a verified digest. The next pass must verify three things:
1. The verified digest actually feeds preLoadArtifactHash and cacheEligibleWeightHash, which are the SSD prefix-cache binding in T-041 and the weight-substitution defense in T-012 and T-027.
2. Where glmPlan is non-nil, the load still fails closed (identityMismatch) if the digest is absent or differs from the manifest aggregate.
3. The TOCTOU window between verification and mmap/load is not widened, since glmPlan.weights.recheck() is retained.

Coverage limit: the changed hunks around lines 1964-2006 were not supplied in numbered text, so I cannot confirm safety there. Deeper review is warranted.
